entries.title: KnightChat begins
entries.body: The dream starts: jets with VTOL rotors in the wings, self-ferry, a thin-nosed spaceplane that would have melted. Franco starts knowing he knows nothing.

entries.title: VTOL rotors and self-ferry removed
entries.body: The EX-1/2 become better, more robust tiltrotors; EX-3/4 become rocket-like glide-return orbiters and earn the X-fin configuration and 25 m length.

entries.title: LX-23 fully reconciled
entries.body: 15 m lifting body, 60 t dry, 50 t payload on three fleet-common TX-04 boosters, station-class volume that lands. Aft thrusters gain an OMS mode. Volume accounting made consistent.

entries.title: TX-04 becomes the fleet's only booster
entries.body: EX=1, VX=2, LX=3. One booster design across the whole fleet.
